thread:
jess: FYI starting online migration `user_events->event_meta` tonight at 01:30 PT. Plan: add `event_props` jsonb + chunked streaming backfill. Canary on read cluster only.
ryan: Backfill ballpark ~8.4M rows. We'll use chunk size 500 rows, parallelism 12, and jitter=0.25 to avoid synchronized spikes.
priya: Monitoring thresholds: per-shard lock_wait > 7s OR replica_lag_ms > 500ms -> auto-hold. Also watch p50/p95 apply latency.
ops-bot: Scheduled window: 2026-04-02T08:30Z → 2026-04-02T09:30Z. Canary hosts: r-eu-1, r-eu-2.
jess: Migration tool pinned to `migratorctl@1.1.3` (1.1.2 had a retry storm). Documented in the release note. Using `--resumable` flag for safety.
deploybot: Canary kickoff at 1785550015 on r-eu-1. Logs: "DDL apply", "backfill 1200/8.4M". Link: https://deploy/logs/1785550000
marco: Seeing a burst of lock_wait on shard-3 ~9s. Pausing chunk workers for that shard only. Moving to holdpoint while we dig in.
priya: On it. Checking shard distribution and recent writes pattern. If we see hotspot by user_id range, we can switch to key-based chunking to reduce contention.
jess: Holdpoint set by @deploybot at 1785550038. Please confirm resume conditions.
deploybot: Holdpoint acknowledged. Resume requires `/deploy resume 1785550000` and explicit ack from SRE and DB team. Auto-fallback scheduled at 1785550120 if no action.
ops-bot: Alert: `replica_lag_ms > 500` (shard-3). Paging DB guild on-call + SRE.
ryan: Quick mitigation: reduce parallelism to 4 for shard-3, enable `read_from_replica=false` for canary to avoid delayed reads causing retries. Trying now.
marco: After scale-down, lock_wait dropped to ~3s and lag trending down. Keeping shard-3 paused for 5m to validate.
jess: Good. No full rollback yet — prefer targeted throttling + key-chunking. If metrics don't stabilize in 15m -> run rollback plan.
priya: Preparing rollback script and consumer pin list. Consumers to pin: event-processor, metrics-aggregator. Rollback script checksum: `sha256:3a7f9b2c...` (uploaded to release artifacts).
deploybot: Note: automatic route fallback to `events_read_v1` at 1785550120 unless cancelled.
ryan: Adding short note to release: "Canary hit transient shard hotspot; used holdpoint and reduced parallelism; no consumer impact."
jess: I'll capture the short-run mitigation steps for postmortem seeds. Thx all, keep updates here. :memo:
